forbidden_result: A routing/orchestration Skill has no decision diagram.
obligations.observable_result: A decision diagram exists for the routing/orchestration Skill.
obligations.state_after: The Skill has a decision diagram.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill is being assessed.
obligations.subject: Routing/orchestration Skills
obligations.trigger: A Skill performs routing or orchestration.

obligations.expected_behavior: Link the decision diagram from the Skill.
forbidden_result: The required decision diagram exists but is not linked from the Skill.
obligations.observable_result: The Skill contains a link to its decision diagram.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill has a decision diagram.
obligations.subject: Routing/orchestration Skill decision diagram linkage
obligations.trigger: A decision diagram is provided for a routing/orchestration Skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: Represent the decision diagram in ASCII.
forbidden_result: The required decision diagram is provided only in a non-ASCII representation.
obligations.observable_result: The linked decision diagram uses ASCII.
obligations.state_after: The decision diagram is represented in ASCII.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill requires a decision diagram.
obligations.subject: Routing/orchestration Skill decision diagram format
obligations.trigger: The required decision diagram is authored.

obligations.expected_behavior: Include all three primary example routes in the diagram's declared reachable branch IDs.
forbidden_result: Any of the three primary example routes is absent from the declared reachable branch IDs.
obligations.observable_result: Each of the three primary example routes is included in the diagram's declared reachable branch IDs.
obligations.state_after: All three primary example routes are included in the declared reachable branch IDs.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill has a decision diagram and three primary example routes.
obligations.subject: Declared reachable branch coverage
obligations.trigger: The routing/orchestration Skill's decision diagram declares reachable branch IDs.

obligations.expected_behavior: Explicitly mark the decision-diagram requirement as not applicable to leaf Skills.
forbidden_result: A leaf Skill's not-applicable classification is left implicit.
obligations.observable_result: The decision-diagram requirement is explicitly recorded as not applicable for a leaf Skill.
obligations.state_after: The leaf Skill has an explicit not-applicable designation.
obligations.state_before: A Skill is a leaf Skill.
obligations.subject: Leaf Skill applicability designation
obligations.trigger: The decision-diagram requirement is assessed for a leaf Skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail the assessment when a required decision diagram is missing.
forbidden_result: A routing/orchestration Skill passes despite a missing decision diagram.
obligations.observable_result: A missing required diagram produces a failing assessment.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill lacks its required decision diagram.
obligations.subject: Missing-diagram failure condition
obligations.trigger: Assessment detects a missing required decision diagram.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail the assessment when a branch is unresolved.
forbidden_result: A routing/orchestration Skill passes with an unresolved branch.
obligations.observable_result: An unresolved branch produces a failing assessment.
obligations.state_before: A routing/orchestration Skill has an unresolved branch.
obligations.subject: Unresolved-branch failure condition

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail the assessment when a Skill is falsely classified as a leaf while declaring routing.
forbidden_result: A Skill declaring routing passes through a false leaf classification.
obligations.observable_result: A leaf classification accompanied by declared routing produces a failing assessment.
obligations.state_before: A Skill is classified as a leaf despite declaring routing.
obligations.subject: False-leaf failure condition
obligations.trigger: Assessment detects a false leaf classification with declared routing.

obligations.expected_behavior: Exempt a real leaf Skill from the decision-diagram requirement.
forbidden_result: A real leaf Skill is required to provide a decision diagram.
A real leaf Skill fails solely because it has no decision diagram.
obligations.observable_result: A real leaf Skill can satisfy this criterion without a decision diagram when explicitly designated not applicable.
obligations.state_after: No decision diagram is required for the real leaf Skill.
obligations.state_before: The assessed Skill is a real leaf Skill.
obligations.subject: Real leaf Skill diagram exemption
obligations.trigger: The decision-diagram requirement is evaluated for a real leaf Skill.
